note: Fri 13 Nov 2026 07:02 SGT run, before Asia's open (SGX/HKEX), against Thu 12 Nov US close. Overnight/Thu headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned effective immediately (Nov 12) amid the national-security/affair scandal flagged in Wed's note -- CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO; Nvidia's market cap fell below $4T for the first time since Jul 2025. Fear & Greed scraper mirrors are unusually inconsistent again this run (readings of 19, 37, 43 and 60 all surfaced for what should be the same Thu close) -- 43/Fear is used as the best-supported figure (two independent mentions, and it is the only one consistent with CNN's own 25-44=Fear banding; the 60 'Greed' figure traced to a different 10-factor composite, and 19/'Extreme Fear' and the '66 Greed' figure could not be corroborated elsewhere). Crypto F&G (28, Fear) was confirmed directly from alternative.me and is reliable. Breadth deteriorated under the hood on Thu even though the S&P/Nasdaq were only modestly lower (-0.35%/-0.39%): NYSE decliners outpaced advancers ~2.8-to-1 and Nasdaq ~2.87-to-1 (vs 1.48-to-1 advancers on Wed), and Nasdaq new lows widened to 215 vs just 40 new highs -- confirms the narrow/fragile character already flagged on Wed is deepening, not healing. Flows are unchanged in vintage from the prior run (week ended 4 Nov 2026) -- no fresher Lipper/EPFR cut has published yet, so Thu's sharp gold/silver/BTC selloff and the Nvidia CEO news are not yet reflected in any flow data.
